name: olai-plugin-mail
//name: UNSCOPED, for `olai-plugin-odu`'s reason one appliance over: `@olai/*` is the scope for the packages that ARE olai, and a tenant is named the way a plugin written outside this tree would be.
//exports: The doors this plugin opens: `./wire` is the account cell and the two procedures, the declaration everything that composes this surface pulls in statically; `./server` is the Cordis plugin (the token broker, the generated Himalaya config, the OAuth route); `./browser` is the header pill and the row's Connect/Disconnect face, a CHUNK fetched only when the roster names this row; `./testids` is names only, so `packages/tests` can assert on this plugin's DOM without SolidJS on its graph; `./all.css` is the Tailwind source; `./appliance/testlib` is the fake Himalaya and the fake Google the e2e harness spawns. There is NO `./appliance/*` wire door — Himalaya has no MCP face and no client package, so the plugin shells out to the pinned binary and nothing of Himalaya is imported here.
//dependencies: Effect and plugin-api provide declared services and activation lifetimes. The Effect bridge gate owns direct tool calls; ops supplies tool contracts and format supplies its refusal union. Solid and ui-primitives are the browser face. Runtime capabilities are acquired in server apply, never imported from another plugin.
//devDependencies: `olai-plugin-layout` and `olai-plugin-plugin-inspector` for their slot CONTRACTS only — the declarations that make `app.header` and `plugins.row` names the compiler knows (odu's browser half merges the same three), and the row face this plugin hangs on its own row. A contract module is the one thing that may travel between two plugin packages, and the inspector's own manifest records `olai-plugin-layout` the same way. `@olai/tests` is the e2e harness the feature files under `e2e/` are written against.
